# Canva

> > Canva is a visual design platform offering collaborative tools through the Canva Visual Suite for creating graphics, videos, presentations, and marketing materials.

Canva provides a comprehensive ecosystem including partner programs, business solutions, and creative tools. The platform enables individuals and organizations to design professional content with an extensive partner network supporting implementation and services.

## Key Topics

- Canva Visual Suite
- Partner Directory
- Business Partnerships
- Partner Program
- Partner Finder
- Canva Partners
- Design Platform
- Visual Content Creation
- YouTube Integration
- Collaborative Design Tools

## Partner Network

- [Find a Canva partner | Canva partner directory](https://partners.canva.com/): Directory to find and connect with trusted Canva partners for business
